# Graphiant Provider

The Graphiant provider is the official Terraform provider for provisioning and managing Graphiant Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) infrastructure as code: sites, IAM users and groups, gateways and data exchange (public VIF, local extranet, and B2B partner peering), software rollouts, alerting, and more. For network configuration, prefer the Automation Workflows resources (graphiant_playbook_config and graphiant_playbook_job): their catalog bundles run the graphiant-playbooks modules, which handle the underlying APIs, behind validation, a dry-run and an approval gate. Authenticate with a static access token or a username/password pair, either in the provider block or via GRAPHIANT_ACCESS_TOKEN, or GRAPHIANT_USERNAME and GRAPHIANT_PASSWORD, environment variables.

See the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Graphiant-Inc/terraform-provider-graphiant)
for the full resource/data source coverage list, and [Graphiant Docs](https://docs.graphiant.com)
for product documentation on the NaaS platform this provider manages.

## Recommended: Automation Workflows

For network configuration, start with `graphiant_playbook_config` and
`graphiant_playbook_job`. Each catalog bundle (System, Network, Services,
Gateway Services, Policies, Routing, System Objects, Data Exchange, Data
Exchange Local) runs the [graphiant-playbooks](https://github.com/Graphiant-Inc/graphiant-playbooks)
modules as a managed service, and those modules already handle the underlying
device, policy and routing APIs. You supply YAML. Graphiant validates it, runs a
mandatory dry-run and deploys only after `approve = true`, with every run in
one audit log. Use the other resources only for objects no bundle covers yet.
See [Graphiant Automation Workflows](https://docs.graphiant.com/docs/graphiant-automation-workflows).

## Authentication

Configure exactly one of:

- `access_token` (or the `GRAPHIANT_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable) — a
  static bearer token. Takes precedence over `username`/`password` if both
  are set.
- `username` + `password` (or `GRAPHIANT_USERNAME` + `GRAPHIANT_PASSWORD`) —
  exchanged for a bearer token via the Graphiant login endpoint on each
  provider `Configure`.

`host` defaults to `https://api.graphiant.com`; override it in the provider
block or via `GRAPHIANT_API_HOST`/`GRAPHIANT_HOST` for a different tenant
endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    graphiant = {
      source = "Graphiant-Inc/graphiant"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials can also be supplied via GRAPHIANT_ACCESS_TOKEN, or
# GRAPHIANT_USERNAME + GRAPHIANT_PASSWORD, and the host via GRAPHIANT_API_HOST.
provider "graphiant" {
  host         = "https://api.graphiant.com"
  access_token = var.graphiant_access_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer access token for the Graphiant API. Takes precedence over username/password. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable.
- `host` (String) Graphiant API base URL. Defaults to https://api.graphiant.com. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_API_HOST or GRAPHIANT_HOST environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Graphiant password. Used with username to obtain an access token when access_token is not set. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `username` (String) Graphiant username. Used with password to obtain an access token when access_token is not set. Can also be set via the GRAPHIANT_USERNAME environment variable.
